# Install

You need two programs on your `PATH`: [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) to run the renderer, and [Quarto](https://quarto.org) to build the HTML. Nothing else is installed globally.

## Run without installing

`uvx` fetches the renderer into a throwaway environment and runs it:

```bash
uvx --from git+https://github.com/DSestu/quarto-templates dsestu-render notebook.py
```

For a private clone, swap the URL for `git+ssh://git@github.com/DSestu/quarto-templates`.

## Install the extension into a project

When you render with `quarto render` yourself, add the format extension once per project:

```bash
quarto add DSestu/quarto-templates
```

Then set the format in the document or in `_quarto.yml`:

```yaml
format:
  dsestu-dark-html: default
```

## Check the setup

```bash
quarto --version   # 1.4 or newer
uv --version
```
